name: Wi-Fi module ESP-01S (ESP8266, AT firmware)
description: ESP8266 Wi-Fi module with Espressif's AT command firmware, talked to over a serial port. Uno wiring: VCC → 3V3, GND → GND, TX → D2 (SoftwareSerial RX), RX → D3 (SoftwareSerial TX) through a 1 kΩ / 2 kΩ divider. In Jumper it joins the sandbox Wi-Fi "JumperNet" (open) and reaches sandbox hosts such as the pet AI at http://ai.jumper/v1/pet.

pins.label: TX
pins.description: Serial out of the module (3.3 V logic). To the board's RX pin, e.g. Uno D2 for SoftwareSerial esp(2, 3).

pins.label: EN
pins.description: Chip enable (CH_PD). The ESP-01S has a 12 kΩ pull-up; LOW switches the module off.

pins.label: IO2
pins.description: GPIO2. Not used by the AT firmware; must not be held LOW at power-up.

pins.label: RST
pins.description: Reset, active LOW, 12 kΩ pull-up on the ESP-01S.

pins.label: IO0
pins.description: GPIO0. LOW at power-up enters the flash bootloader; leave unwired for normal use.

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V supply, NOT 5 V. Draws about 80 mA, with 170 to 300 mA peaks while transmitting.

pins.label: RX
pins.description: Serial into the module (3.3 V logic). From the board's TX pin, e.g. Uno D3, through a 1k/2k divider on 5 V boards.

props.label: UART baud rate
props.description: Rate the module's AT firmware listens at. New modules ship at 115200, which SoftwareSerial cannot receive reliably on an Uno: send AT+UART_DEF=9600,8,1,0,0 once (the setting is saved in the module) and talk at 9600.

footprint: 24.8 x 14.3 mm module, 2 x 4 pin 0.1 in header

bindings.description: 3.0 to 3.6 V on VCC with EN and RST high.
off, idle (booted, not joined), connecting, connected, or down (the Wi-Fi went away; the module reconnects by itself).
Joined with an IP (after WIFI GOT IP).
Station IP, empty when not joined.
